text:
Priya (Product): Hey all — NebulaHealth pilot asks to go live with private deploy next month. Need a short triage: launch criteria, minimum infra commitment, runtime perf targets, and security gating. Can we align today?
Sam (Eng): +1. main unknowns: throughput per customer, cold-start latency SLA, and model variant (7B quant vs 13B fp16).
Jordan (Runtime): From runtime side we need: 99th-pctl p99 <= 300ms for chat completions under 95% traffic, and ability to fallback to a smaller quantized variant when load spikes. Also need KV cache priming for common prompts.
Marta (Infra): Capacity ask: for pilot we'll reserve 4 GPUs (A10s) in the private pool, with autoscale-to-8 for bursts. Need exact expected RPS and sequence length distribution.
Elliot (Security): Security gating: customer requires KMS-backed key store + HSM for signing during audit windows. Also need a short absorb checklist for SOC-type access (audit logs, egress controls).
Lia (PM): Customer expectations: 99.5% availability during business hours, <400ms median latency, and data residency inside eu-west-1. They've accepted a pilot SLA with 24/7 oncall support for first 2 weeks.
Priya (Product): OK — let's map concrete acceptance criteria. Proposal: (1) Functional: model outputs match baseline eval on 5 customer prompts with no regression >5% ROUGE drop. (2) Perf: p50 <200ms, p95 <350ms, p99 <600ms. (3) Ops: autoscale <8 GPUs, prewarm cache within 10m. (4) Security: KMS + audit logs enabled. Thoughts?
Jordan (Runtime): Baseline eval makes sense but we should do quality A/B on the quantized 7B variant vs 13B fp16. If the 7B quant drops quality >4% on customer prompts, we don't auto-fallback. Also request a runtime flag to force 13B for canary traffic.
Sam (Eng): Agree. Can we add a canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on latency or regression? We can implement rollout policy in the routing layer.
Marta (Infra): For autoscaling policy, suggest: target_cpu_util 65, queue_latency_trigger 250ms, scale_step 2 GPUs, cool_down 300s. I can draft terraform snippet.
Marta (Infra): ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "nebula_pilot" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
  min_gpus = 4
  max_gpus = 8
  instance_type = "A10G"
}
```
Elliot (Security): That HCL looks fine. On KMS: will need key rotation policy, and we must ensure that logs are forwarded to the customer's SIEM and retained 90 days. Also need a customer-facing runbook for key escrow requests.
Lia (PM): Timeline ask from customer: pilot kickoff in 3 weeks, 2-week validation window. Realistic?
Jordan (Runtime): Tight but doable if we lock scope now. Main dev tasks: quant profile tuning, cache priming script, rollout flag. Estimate: 10 dev-days + 3 infra-days.
Sam (Eng): I'll commit to the 10 dev-days if we can deprioritize the non-essential UI changes. Need an owner for test prompt set and eval harness.
Priya (Product): Lia, you own collecting the 20 pilot prompts and acceptance evals from NebulaHealth by EOD Friday. Sam, Jordan, Marta, Elliot — owners for technical work.
Sam (Eng): Owner for test harness: Sam. ETA: 2 weeks.
Jordan (Runtime): Owner for runtime changes & rollout flag: Jordan. ETA: 10 business days.
Marta (Infra): Owner for infra/tf and capacity reservation: Marta. ETA: 5 business days to spin up pool and 1 day for validation.
Elliot (Security): Security owner: Elliot. I'll draft the KMS config and runbook. ETA: 4 business days.
Priya (Product): Action items captured: 
- Lia: collect 20 prompts + baseline eval set (due Fri EOD)
- Sam: implement eval harness + integration with CI (due 2w)
- Jordan: runtime changes + canary flag + cache priming script (due 10bd)
- Marta: reserve GPUs, terraform, autoscale rules (due 5bd)
- Elliot: KMS/HSM config, log forwarding, runbook (due 4bd)
Add these to the initiative board and tag owners.
Lia (PM): I'll create the ticket board now and ping stakeholders.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled when Jordan pushes the feature branch. Use `/deploy canary --percent=5` to start.
Sam (Eng): One more risk: model quantization might increase tokenization differences for some medical abbreviations. We'll add a 10-prompt medical abbreviation check in the eval set.
Priya (Product): Good catch — Lia, add that to the 20 prompts.
Lia (PM): Added.
Jordan (Runtime): Quick checklist for go/no-go pre-launch: 
- Performance regression <5% vs baseline on eval set
- Retrofit alerting on p95/p99
- Successful canary at 5% for 24h with no rollbacks
- KMS & logs validated end-to-end
- Capacity validation (sustained 95th-percentile load for 30m)
I'll paste this into the checklist ticket.
Marta (Infra): Also confirm network egress rules for the VPC and the customer's allowed IP ranges. I'll request the CIDR list from Lia.
Lia (PM): CIDR request sent to customer.
Elliot (Security): Also adding requirement: penetration test cursory scan before pilot. Can we schedule lightweight scan in week 1?
Sam (Eng): Yes, infra can open a test window. Marta, coordinate.
Marta (Infra): Will do.
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene in 48 hours for a short sync — post updates in the ticket threads. If any blocker pops up before then, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Sounds good.
Jordan (Runtime): Copy.
Marta (Infra): Acknowledged.
Elliot (Security): On it.
Lia (PM): I'll set the follow-up calendar.
Priya (Product): End of thread notes: owners and due dates added to the initiative board. I'll put an executive one-pager after the first validation run.
